symbols.name: vector space
symbols.meaning: A vector space over the field F, whose linear functionals form the dual space.
symbols.quote: Let $U$ be a vector space over the field $F$.

symbols.name: dual space
symbols.meaning: The vector space of all linear functionals on U.
symbols.quote: The dual space $U^*$ collects every [Linear functional](linear-functional.md) on $U$ into one vector space.

symbols.name: linear functional
symbols.meaning: A generic element of the dual space U^*, which is a linear map from U to F.
symbols.quote: The elements of $U^*$ are written $f$; each is a map $f: U \to F$ that is linear, so $f(x+y)=f(x)+f(y)$ and $f(cx)=cf(x)$ for vectors $x,y$ and scalars $c$ in $F$.

symbols.name: example functional
symbols.meaning: The linear functional on R^2 sending x to 3x_1 - x_2.
symbols.quote: Let $\sigma$ be the functional $\sigma(x)=3x_1-x_2$ and $\rho$ the functional $\rho(x)=x_1$.

symbols.name: second example functional
symbols.meaning: The linear functional on R^2 sending x to x_1.
symbols.quote: Let $\sigma$ be the functional $\sigma(x)=3x_1-x_2$ and $\rho$ the functional $\rho(x)=x_1$.

relations.quote: The dual space $U^*$ collects every [Linear functional](linear-functional.md) on $U$ into one vector space.
Under pointwise addition and scalar multiplication, $U^*$ satisfies the axioms of a vector space, as set out in [Linear algebra basics](linear-algebra-basics.md).
